WELCOME_SUB: Isango Lokunika Amandla i-Afrika Nge-Pi Ecosystem
AFRICA_DAY: (Ekugubheni uSuku lwe-Afrika lwama-25, lolu hlelo lokuqeqesha lwe-Pi Pioneers luyethulwa)
INTRO_P1: I-Pi Network iyiphrojekthi yemali yedijithali yomhlaba wonke kanye ne-ecosystem eklanyelwe ukwenza i-cryptocurrency ifinyeleleke futhi ibe usizo kubantu bansuku zonke.
INTRO_P2: Ngokungafani nama-cryptocurrency endabuko avamise ukudinga imishini yokumba ebizayo nokusetshenziswa kukagesi omningi, i-Pi Network ivumela abantu abajwayelekile ukuthi babambe iqhaza ngokuqondile besebenzisa omakhalekhukhwini babo.
INTRO_P3: Umbono we-Pi Network ukwakha i-ecosystem eqhutshwa abantu lapho imali yedijithali ingasetshenziswa khona ngenzuzo yangempela, izinsizakalo zangempela, imiphakathi yangempela kanye nokubamba iqhaza komnotho kwangempela.
M1: Yakha umnotho wedijithali obandakanya wonke umuntu
M2: Nika amandla abantu abajwayelekile emhlabeni wonke
CH1_SUB: Wamukelekile e-Afrika Pioneers Education Hub - External. Le nkundla yakhelwe ukufundisa, ukunika amandla kanye nokulungiselela amavulandlela ase-Afrika namabhizinisi ukuze abambe iqhaza ngokoqobo ku-Pi Ecosystem.
REG2: Bhalisa usebenzisa i-Facebook noma Inombolo Yocingo
DAILY_MINING: Ukumba Nsuku Zonke: Buya njalo emahoreni angama-24 ukuze uqhubeke nokumba.
WALLET_SEC: Ukuphepha kwe-Wallet: Ungalokothi wabelane ngamagama akho ayi-24 e-Passphrase. Noma ubani olawula i-passphrase ulawula i-wallet.
CH2_DESC: Funda ukuthi ungayithola futhi uthumele kanjani i-Pi ngokuphephile usebenzisa i-Pi Wallet ku-Pi Browser.
CH2A_DESC: Qala ngamanani amancane okuhlola, qinisekisa amakheli, ungalokothi wabelane nge-passphrase.
CH3_DESC: Ama-DApps e-Pi Browser yizinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlukaniselwe izindawo zenzuzo yangempela.
CH4_DESC: Thola amabhizinisi ahambisana ne-Pi emhlabeni wonke.
CH5_DESC: Inani Lokuvumelana Lomhlaba Wonke likhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwangempela kwe-ecosystem.
CH6_DESC: Funda i-Handbook ka-Doris Yin yokudala ukusetshenziswa kanye nokukhula kwe-ecosystem.
MERCHANT_DESC: Indlela yokujoyina i-ecosystem, ukufaka ibhizinisi ku-MapOfPi, ukwamukela izinkokhelo ze-Pi.
FINAL_P: I-Afrika inethuba lokuba esinye sezifunda ezinamandla kakhulu zokusetshenziswa okungokoqobo ngaphakathi kwe-Pi Ecosystem. Sakha Ndawonye. Sifundisa Ndawonye. Sinika Amandla i-Afrika Ndawonye Nge-Pi.
